title: Joseph von Chlingensperg auf Berg, partially encrypted diary (1830)
shelfmark: Beinecke, Chlingensperg family diaries, GEN MSS 1495, Series II, Box 3
status: Archives at Yale title "Partially encrypted diary". The same series holds a 20th-century "Translation of 1811 diary, with related papers" (Box 2), which may give the system. Not digitised, not on DECODE, not in repo.
why: A Bavarian noble diary of the Napoleonic and Restoration years kept partly in cipher.
verify: Request scans; check the Box 2 translation papers for the key.
